Round 23 **passes**: every acceptance check I ran passed on its own test. I also found one new medium-severity bug, C-R23-01. It doesn't break any round-23 criterion, but B needs to route it.

**Round 23 checks (all re-run myself, without relying on A's numbers):**
- **Fold button points at the lane body (R23-F1):** on all 4 lanes the fold button's reference resolves to that lane's own body, outside the header, and contains its clips. The 4 ids are unique.
  - Real clicks fold the lane to 36 px and unfold it to 81 px.
  - Space on the fold button folds the lane without starting playback.
- **Fold refused during a drag (R23-F2):** both Space and a real click are refused while a clip drag is held, with the correct status message. After release, one click folds the lane.
- **Name-button focus ring (R23-N):** tested at 1440├ù900 and 1280├ù720, on a folded music lane and on the video lane at 52 px. The ring is drawn inside the button. On the 52 px lane the button's top sits exactly at the header's top edge, which is where an outside ring would have been cut. The cropped screenshots show the full ring.
- **Nearby behaviour (R23-R):** unchanged.
  - File drop onto the video lane gives one clip at 0ΓÇô6.008.
  - Library drop onto music at 7 s gives one clip.
  - Tab order in the headers is the same as before.
  - Mute works on a folded lane.
  - The height handle moves ┬▒8.
- **Code diff and tests (R23-S, R23-U):** the diff contains only the allowed lines.
  - I ran my own mutation checks in a copy outside `store/`. Removing either change makes exactly the matching new test fail.
  - A's red-first output (both new tests failing before the change) is confirmed from A's saved test output.
- **Doc (R23-Doc):** doc 029 matches the code.
- **Gates:**
  - Type check passes. All 1007 tests pass, which is 1005 plus A's 2 new ones. The build passes.
  - Biome shows 0 errors and the same 218 warnings as round 22.
  - 50 frozen files OK. `git status` shows 46 lines. The 4 protected files and `Header.tsx` are unchanged.
- **No premium bypass (G23-3):** in a fresh browser context with no credentials, the demo loads. It makes no token, recording, download or R2 requests and sends no auth header. The token endpoint returns 401, and `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required".
- **Export:** a real WAV export of the 4-clip layout (video, music, stems, SFX) gives 864,000 frames (18.000 s), a valid header and no NaN samples. 1800 samples hit full scale; that clipping is already known (R13-M4).

**New bug C-R23-01 (medium):**
- **What:** the server-rendered `/studio-lab` page contains 4 null bytes.
  - One pair lands in visible text ("Arrangement ┬╖ ∩┐╜∩┐╜ßâ¢ßâùßâÜßâÿßâÉßâ£ßâÿ ßâ₧ßâáßâ¥ßâößâÑßâóßâÿ"). Hydration repairs that text in the browser.
  - The other pair lands in the music lane's name-button label, which reads "ßâ¢ßâúßâíßâÿßâÖßâÉ ΓÇö ∩┐╜∩┐╜ßâÉßâÑßâóßâÿßâúßâáßâÿΓÇª". That label stays corrupted after hydration, so a screen reader announces garbage for the whole session.
- **Cause:** React 18.3.1's server renderer writes data in 2048-byte blocks. When a 3-byte Georgian character doesn't fit at the end of a block, it sends the whole block including the empty bytes. The production build has the same code.
- **Who caused it:** the bug predates round 23. Round 23's added bytes may have moved one pair onto the music label, but I have no round-22 page capture to prove or rule that out.
- **Routing:** the fix needs a React upgrade or an `entry.server.tsx` change, and both are frozen. This goes to the Tech Lead/root, not A's round 24.

**My own mistakes (all recovered):**
- My first scratch test run failed because of a config error in my copy; I fixed it and re-ran everything.
- My first export click used the wrong selector and never clicked; the retry worked.
- A stray Ctrl+Z undid the SFX clip; I redid it before the final fold click.
